instruction.text: This is a map of Melanesia. Select the rainforest to learn more.

atoms.b: New ((++Guinea Guernsey)), divided between Indonesia and Papua New Guinea, contains Oceania’s largest tropical rainforest and has the highest plant biodiversity of any island in the world.
atoms.sound: New Guinea, divided between Indonesia and Papwa New Guinea, contains Oceania’s largest tropical rainforest and has the highest plant biodiversity of any island in the world.

atoms.b: The island is also home to 38 of the world’s 43 birds-of-paradise species. These birds are famous for their colourful ((++feathers claws)) and elaborate courtship dances.
97% of Papua New Guinea’s land belongs to indigenous communities rather than the state. This gives them ((++more less)) power to protect the rainforest from destructive logging.
atoms.sound: 97% of Papwa New Guinea’s land belongs to indigenous communities rather than the state. This gives them more power to protect the rainforest from destructive logging.

atoms.a: At 361 metres tall, Vanuatu’s Mount Yasur has been erupting almost continuously for more than 800 years.
atoms.sound: At 361 metres tall, Vanuatu’s Mount Ya-sur has been erupting almost continuously for more than 800 years.

atoms.a: Visitors can stand right at the crater’s edge, making it one of the world’s most accessible active volcanoes.
The ash deposits create nutrient-rich volcanic soil, ideal for growing yams, bananas and coffee.
atoms.sound: The ash deposits create nutrient rich volcanic soil, ideal for growing yams, bananas and coffee.

atoms.a: Vanuatu is also famous for the tradition of sand drawing, which involves creating intricate designs in volcanic sand.

atoms.b: Meke is a traditional art form originating in Fiji that combines dance, music and chanting to create a unique form of ((++storytelling cooking)).
In Fijian mythology, meke was traditionally believed to be a ((++gift curse)) from the gods, helping to pass down history and cultural values through generations.
Meke dancers typically wear costumes made from ((++natural processed)) materials, including grass skirts and floral garlands.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Melanesia is one of the most linguistically diverse regions in the world, with over 1,300 languages across 2,000 islands. For this reason, most countries here rely on a shared language to help people communicate more easily.
In Papua New Guinea, for example, Tok Pisin is an English-based shared language with official status. It connects speakers of over 800 indigenous languages across the country.
atoms.sound: In Papwa New Guinea, for example, Tawk Pissin is an English-based shared language with official status. It connects speakers of over 800 indigenous languages across the country.

atoms.text: However, many indigenous languages risk disappearing as more people use the shared ones instead. To help preserve them, Vanuatu now requires schools to teach local languages and records them using dictionaries and writing systems.

atoms.a: Why do most Melanesian countries have a shared language?
b: to make it harder for people to communicate
to make people speak more quietly

atoms.a: Where does the shared language Tok Pisin have official status?
atoms.sound: Where does the shared language Tawk Pissin have official status?

atoms.a: Why are many Melanesian languages at risk of disappearing?
b: ++They are being replaced by shared languages.
They are not allowed to be spoken.
They are too similar to other languages.
